name: Label Studio Prelabeling Dataset Versioning
purpose: Connects Label Studio to Backblaze B2 as source and target storage, pre-labels tasks with a local model, and exports versioned, verified dataset releases back to the same bucket.
tagline: Pre-label, correct and release datasets with Label Studio on B2.

features.title: Labeling Projects
features.summary: create, edit, delete and run projects bound to Label Studio source and target storage on B2

features.title: Pre-label Runs
features.summary: local object detector writes versioned suggestions to B2 and into Label Studio

features.title: Dataset Releases
features.summary: immutable COCO releases with a manifest, written back to B2

features.title: Verification
features.summary: compare tasks, pre-labels, annotations and release files, and flag missing labels

features.title: Dataset Library
features.summary: browse raw images, pre-label runs, annotations and releases per project

features.title: Raw Image Upload
features.summary: upload raw images straight to a project's B2 prefix

features.title: File Browser
features.summary: browse, preview, download and delete any object in the bucket

features.title: Dashboard
features.summary: projects, tasks, annotated tasks, releases and recent releases

features.title: Settings
features.summary: theme, default pre-label threshold and service status

features.title: Metadata Extraction
features.summary: image dimensions, EXIF and checksums in the bucket explorer

features.title: Label Studio Stack
features.summary: Docker Compose with Label Studio and the ML backend

b2_surface.why: count raw images, list pre-label runs, annotations and release files; Label Studio source sync
read annotation JSON for the COCO build and verification; the ML backend reads task images
write pre-labels, release files and project descriptors; Label Studio target storage writes annotations
release immutability check, file checks in verification, and the /health probe
the browser uploads raw images straight to B2
downloads and previews; Label Studio shows task images
bucket explorer delete and the optional purge of a project's B2 data

stack.web: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query
stack.api: FastAPI, Python 3.12+, boto3, httpx, Pydantic v2, Pillow

env_vars.name: B2_APPLICATION_KEY_ID
env_vars.note: B2 application key ID (**keyID** in the B2 console)

env_vars.name: B2_APPLICATION_KEY
env_vars.note: B2 application key (**applicationKey**), shown once at creation

env_vars.name: B2_BUCKET_NAME
env_vars.note: bucket unique name (**Bucket Unique Name** in the B2 console)

env_vars.name: B2_REGION
env_vars.note: the region inside the bucket's **Endpoint** (`s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com`); the S3 endpoint is derived from it

env_vars.name: B2_PUBLIC_URL_BASE
env_vars.note: public object base URL, when the bucket is public

env_vars.name: LABEL_STUDIO_URL
env_vars.note: Label Studio base URL; defaults to http://localhost:8080

env_vars.name: LABEL_STUDIO_API_TOKEN
env_vars.note: API token for the bootstrap admin; `pnpm setup` generates it and Docker Compose passes it to Label Studio

env_vars.name: LABEL_STUDIO_USERNAME
env_vars.note: local bootstrap admin email for Label Studio

env_vars.name: LABEL_STUDIO_PASSWORD
env_vars.note: local bootstrap admin password for Label Studio

env_vars.name: ML_BACKEND_URL
env_vars.note: ML backend base URL as the API reaches it; defaults to http://localhost:9090

env_vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
env_vars.note: separate-origin deploys only; Next.js inlines it at build time
